purpose: Defend Garrett's strongest actual interpretation against Millican, while following primary evidence and later qualifications.
verdict: Positive support for dependency on custom and distinct inferential/evaluative boundaries; unresolved pressure on invalid demonstrative steps and immediate causation of particular predictions; no novelty or complete vindication claimed.
